ad:
Senior Backend Engineer (Berlin, hybrid). Salary EUR 95,000–115,000 per year.

Parcelwise routes parcels for regional couriers. You will design and operate the Go services that assign shipments to carriers, model delivery data in PostgreSQL and keep our event pipeline healthy.

Essential: production Go service design and operation; PostgreSQL data modelling and query performance.
Preferred: event-driven systems with Kafka; ownership of on-call for your services.

Individual contributor role, no direct reports.
